fields.summary_ko.0: Dell Technologies (DELL) is ahead of its November 24 earnings release, with GF Securities cutting its target price from $497 to $341, a 31% reduction.
fields.summary_ko.1: AI server sales are projected to reach approximately $85 billion in fiscal 2027, driving revenue past $200 billion, though subsequent enterprise server shipments are expected to decline 9%.
fields.summary_ko.2: Quarterly revenue of $5.4 billion, EPS of $7.18, and operating margin of 18.4% are expected, with loss of SpaceX orders and intensifying price competition constraining long-term growth.
